name: llm-vendor-waterfall
description: Serve one LLM call from an ordered list of vendors so a rate limit, a dead key, or an out-of-credits account fails over instead of failing the request. Covers the ordered-config to LiteLLM Router mapping, which Router knobs earn their keep (cooldown_time, allowed_fails, context_window_fallbacks, per-deployment budgets) and which to leave alone, the invisible dead fallback that reads as random flakiness, what must not be waterfalled, and how to prove failover actually happens.
author: voitta-ai
